zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 许可与声明面板优化
changes: “许可与声明”现在会像“给用户的信”一样在 App 内面板中打开
许可与声明面板展示随 App 打包的 NOTICE 和 LICENSE 内容，并支持滚动查看与复制
托盘入口文案去掉省略号，中文、繁中和英文菜单显示更干净
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: License & Notices panel polish
changes: License & Notices now opens in an in-app panel like A Note to Users.
The License & Notices panel shows the bundled NOTICE and LICENSE content, with scrolling and selectable text.
The tray entry no longer uses an ellipsis, keeping the Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English menus cleaner.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
